text: Heads up on the BLR Mobility Partners deal — Legal signed the reseller agreement Friday. They guarantee us 500 bookings/month across their Bangalore fleet in exchange for a 12-point discount on our commission for partner-tier accounts booking in Bangalore. Need eng to ship the rate before their April 1 activation.
Confirmed on Finance's side — 0.88x multiplier for partner tier in Bangalore only, everywhere else unchanged. Signed contract is in the partnerships drive if anyone needs the exact terms.
Got it. So this only applies when tier=partner AND city=Bangalore, right? Not partner tier generally?
Correct — city-specific to Bangalore for now. If it goes well we might extend to Mumbai next quarter but that's a separate negotiation, don't build for it yet.

Approving this — good deal for us, locks in volume from a fleet operator we've wanted for a while. Let's not put the BLR relationship details in customer-facing docs though, it's a competitive term we don't want other city operators seeing and asking to match.
Understood, will keep it code-only with a generic comment, no partner name in the repo.
Filed as MER-412, assigning to you Dev.
On it, targeting this week.
PR up: #128. Added PARTNER_CITY_RATES with just Bangalore for now, easy to extend if Mumbai happens later.
Nice, thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming 0.88 matches what I modeled.
Merged and live — thanks all. BLR activation confirmed for April 1.
Reminder: Q2 rate review is next Tuesday, send me any pending city surcharge changes before then.
Dubai base fare — used 140 flat since we don't have surcharge data yet, will revisit after a month of bookings.
Mumbai partner extension is officially on hold, operator wants a much bigger volume commitment than we're comfortable with. Not pursuing for now.
Good call, let's revisit next fiscal year.
Shipping webhook HMAC signing today (#89). Secret lives on Account, one secret per account for now — no key rotation overlap support yet, that's a v2 thing.
Sounds good, let's flag that limitation to Support so they know what to tell customers if they ask about rotating without downtime.
+1, I'll add a note to the internal runbook.

Retry backoff for webhooks: going with 30s/120s/600s (3 retries, ~12 min total). Support originally asked for something closer to 24h — pushing that to a follow-up since redis-based long-delay scheduling needs more design.
Makes sense for launch. Can we make sure docs reflect the actual 3-retry/~12min window and not whatever Support originally asked for?
Yeah agreed, will ping docs. (never got to it — see #general Aug thread, this bit us)
Settlement was recalculating commission at booking time, which means tier changes mid-cycle didn't apply correctly. Fixed to recalc at settlement.
Good catch, that was causing the Orion discrepancy from last month.
FYI bumping session TTL from 4h to 12h, support was getting a lot of 'logged out mid-shift' complaints from dispatch teams.
Dashboard rotation flow for webhook secrets is live. Reminder: rotating immediately invalidates the old secret, there's no overlap window — matches what the docs say.
Worth a heads-up in #support in case customers rotate without updating their endpoint first.
Good call, posting there now.

Heads up support — webhook secret rotation is now self-serve from the dashboard (Settings > Integrations > Webhooks > Signing). Rotating immediately invalidates the old secret, no grace period. If a customer reports webhooks suddenly failing with 401s after saying they 'just rotated something', that's almost certainly it — have them check their endpoint's stored secret matches what's shown in the dashboard.
Got it, will flag in the macro for webhook issues.
Northwind (acct_northwind) opened a ticket about webhooks not firing since ~last week. Checking if this is the rotation thing.
Confirmed — their delivery log shows 401s starting right around Aug 14, same day rotation shipped. Pulling in eng to confirm root cause before I reply.

Checked their account — webhook_signing_secret was rotated Aug 14 in our system but their endpoint is still verifying against the old one. Classic no-overlap rotation gap. They need to update their stored secret to the current one.
Thanks, replying to MER-441 now.
Reminder support team: retry policy is 3 retries over ~12 minutes, NOT the 24h/5-retry thing in the old docs draft — that text still needs fixing, sorry for the confusion it's caused.
Ugh yeah I've quoted the wrong one to a customer before. Filing a docs ticket.
BLR Mobility Partners contract is in final review with Legal. Should close by mid-March.
Great, this is a good template for other regional operator deals if it works out.
Signed Friday 3/13. Eng thread with the rate details is in #pricing.
Volume tracking dashboard for the BLR deal is up — 500/mo commitment, we'll review quarterly.
First month post-activation: BLR delivered 540 bookings, above the guarantee. Good start.
Payments settlement job stuck since ~03:00 UTC, Celery worker OOM. Investigating.
Restarted worker, backlog draining now. Root cause: settlement batch size wasn't capped, a large customer's end-of-month batch blew past memory limits.
Postmortem: incident-2026-05-12-settlement-oom.md, adding batch size cap as follow-up.
Elevated 5xx on /api/bookings for the last 15 minutes, looks like a Postgres connection pool exhaustion.
Bumped pool size, monitoring.
Recovered. Postmortem: incident-2026-07-03-db-pool.md
Welcome Kavya to the eng team!
Support team all-hands moved to Thursdays 10am, calendar updated.
Great quarter everyone — Bangalore partner program off to a strong start, thanks to Priya and Dev's team.
Office closed for the holiday Monday, back Tuesday.
Deploying a small hotfix to staging, should be quick.
